section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “National Missile Defense Act of 1999”.
section.editorialNote: [Section 2 was repealed by section 1681(b) of division A of Public Law 114-328.]

section.heading: POLICY ON REDUCTION OF RUSSIAN NUCLEAR FORCES.
section.content: It is the policy of the United States to seek continued negotiated reductions in Russian nuclear forces.
